title: Safaricom M-Pesa SMS Canonical Regex Conformity
statement: Safaricom M-Pesa SMS transaction receipts strictly follow the standard canonical pattern containing a 10-character alphanumeric transaction ID, numeric currency amount with comma separators, and recipient merchant entity.
rationale: The microservice uses regex extraction rather than a direct synchronous C2B webhook to verify customer Till payments without requiring Safaricom Daraja enterprise portal credentials.
machine_specification: passive_listener.mjs: MPESA_REGEX = /([A-Z0-9]{10})\s+Confirmed\.\s+Ksh([0-9,]+(?:\.[0-9]{2})?)\s+paid\s+to\s+([^.]+)\.\s+on\s+([0-9\/]+)\s+at\s+([0-9:]+\s+[APM]+)/i. Normalizes code to uppercase, strips commas, and executes single-use deduplication in Supabase.
business_requirement: FR-2 [M-Pesa Auto-Reconciliation]: Auto-verify payments in <500ms and transition order from pending_payment to paid.
falsification_scenario: Safaricom alters message formatting (e.g. changing 'Ksh' to 'KES', adding emoji, or inserting promotional survey links between confirmation and amount).
mitigation_strategy: Microservice falls back to secondary flexible regex /([A-Z0-9]{10}).*?(?:Ksh|KES)\s*([0-9,]+)/i and allows manual cashier reconciliation via !order mark-paid <ORDER_ID> or web portal override.

title: Customer / Cashier Forwarding Latency Window (<15 Minutes)
statement: The paying customer or floor cashier forwards the payment SMS to the WhatsApp bot within the 15-minute order reservation window (before expires_at timestamp).
rationale: Store inventory cannot be reserved indefinitely; items must be released to other shoppers if payment proof is not presented.
machine_specification: passive_listener.mjs checks expires_at > NOW(). If expired, the SMS claim is rejected with an expired notice, preserving inventory locks.
business_requirement: FR-3 [Inventory Reservation Integrity]: Prevent overselling and deadlocked stock locks.
falsification_scenario: Customer walks away from till, network delays SMS delivery for 20 minutes, or customer sends receipt after reservation expiration.
mitigation_strategy: FR-7 [Order Resurrection]: Cashier or customer sends !order resurrect <ORDER_ID>, which atomically validates item stock availability, extends expires_at by 2 hours, and immediately processes the pending payment.

title: WhatsApp Multi-Device Companion Message Flagging (fromMe: true)
statement: When a human store manager uses a paired desktop, iPad, or the bot phone itself to issue commands, Baileys emits the message with key.fromMe = true.
rationale: Standard bot implementations discard all messages with fromMe: true to prevent infinite self-echo loops, which accidentally silences store managers.
machine_specification: whatsapp_service.mjs maintains an in-memory botSentMessageIds LRU set. It filters out only messages generated by the bot daemon, while allowing human manager commands on fromMe: true to pass to command_handler.mjs.
business_requirement: FR-6 [Multi-Device Operational Management]: Store managers can execute inventory commands from their personal paired WhatsApp Web sessions.
falsification_scenario: The in-memory Set overflows or process restart clears IDs, causing a brief self-echo cycle.
mitigation_strategy: LRU cache size bounded at 2,000 entries with automatic 1-hour expiration; bot responses always check prefix '!bot' or signature before executing.

title: Motorbike Dispatch Courier Active Data Connectivity
statement: Motorbike courier fulfillment riders maintain an active mobile data bundle (Safaricom/Airtel) and check the WhatsApp Floor Operations group while en route.
rationale: Courier dispatch in the Savannah architecture relies on real-time WhatsApp cards rather than a costly proprietary courier native mobile app.
machine_specification: passive_listener.mjs formats a rich 2-line dispatch card (🚚 DISPATCHED: Order #..., Rider, Delivery Phone wa.me/254...) upon transition to dispatched.
business_requirement: FR-4 [Floor Operations Automated Dispatch]: Sub-minute order handoff from packing station to rider.
falsification_scenario: Rider runs out of mobile data in an urban transit blackspot, missing the WhatsApp dispatch notification.
mitigation_strategy: Direct tel: and wa.me/ links embedded in the card allow the floor manager to trigger an automated SMS or voice call fallback if the rider does not confirm receipt within 10 minutes.

title: Silent Store Manager Catalog Review (Draft Inattention)
statement: Store managers frequently ignore or delay approving AI-generated product photo studio previews sent to WhatsApp due to active walk-in retail floor duties.
rationale: Physical shop managers prioritize physical customers and cash reconciliation over reviewing bot verification cards.
machine_specification: Supabase products table keeps is_active: false by default. Tenant config approval_policy supports: 1) Optimistic (auto-publish immediately with !hide undo), 2) Graceful Timeout (publish after 2 hours), 3) Strict Batch Digest (6:00 PM daily summary).
business_requirement: FR-5 [Automated Catalog Onboarding]: Zero deadlocks in product publishing without compromising storefront aesthetics.
falsification_scenario: Strict mode is enabled and manager ignores drafts for weeks, resulting in unlisted stock and lost online sales.
mitigation_strategy: Automated evening reminder digest sent at 18:00 EAT to Management group with 1-tap !approve all shortcut.

title: Multi-Tenant Shared Till Receipt Disambiguation
statement: Multiple independent tenant storefronts hosted on the same physical gateway might share a single master Safaricom Till number during early incubation.
rationale: Small merchants bootstrapping storefronts often use the umbrella incubator Till before acquiring dedicated Safaricom Business Till licenses.
machine_specification: passive_listener.mjs checks recipient Till in regex, matches against active reserved orders across tenants, and verifies exact 1:1 amount matching. If ambiguous, alerts Executive Oversight group.
falsification_scenario: Two customers across two different shops pay the exact same amount (e.g. KES 1,800) within 3 minutes on a shared Till.
mitigation_strategy: Disambiguation protocol checks order timestamp proximity, prompts customer in 1-on-1 DM for their 8-character Order ID (#XXXXXXXX), or alerts Executive Oversight for manual assignment.

title: Local Commercial Printing Unit Economics (KES 3.00/page)
statement: Commercial cyber cafes, print shops, and stationery bureaus in Nairobi charge KES 3.00 per single-sided A4 monochrome laser printed page.
rationale: Determines the financial feasibility and physical print budget for software requirements binders, SAD binders, and dialogue transcripts.
machine_specification: package_and_count_pages.py calculates exact page counts and printing costs across 4 tiers: Tier 1 (All 28 Architecture Binders, 80 pages = KES 240.00), Tier 2 (Binders + Readable Transcript, 313 pages = KES 939.00), Tier 3 (Full Suite, 736 pages = KES 2,208.00), Tier 4 (947 pages = KES 2,841.00).
business_requirement: NFR-11 [Audit Sizing & Physical Archival Budgeting]: Executive oversight physical archival costs must remain under KES 1,000 for standard review.
falsification_scenario: Print shop charges premium rates (KES 5.00-10.00/page) or imposes minimum volume surcharges.
mitigation_strategy: Tier 1 binder (80 pages) fits comfortably within KES 240.00 even at standard rates; double-sided printing (duplex) reduces bill to KES 120.00-150.00.

title: Supabase PostgreSQL REST Latency & Availability (<300ms)
statement: Supabase cloud database REST endpoints are accessible over residential fiber or mobile hotspot with round-trip latency under 300ms and >99.5% uptime.
rationale: WhatsApp users expect near-instant feedback for bot interactions; high latency creates double-submits and ghost echoes.
machine_specification: tenant_resolver.mjs and command_handler.mjs utilize persistent HTTP keep-alive, 5-second fetch timeouts, and exponential backoff retry on transient 5xx errors.
business_requirement: NFR-1 [Performance]: WhatsApp bot response latency < 1.5 seconds end-to-end.
falsification_scenario: Safaricom residential fiber experiences undersea cable degradation, pushing latency to >2,000ms or causing connection drops.
mitigation_strategy: Gateway queues outgoing WhatsApp notifications in local SQLite / in-memory buffer, and falls back to Tailscale home server local cache.

title: WhatsApp JID Immutability & Tenancy Isolation
statement: WhatsApp group JIDs (@g.us), broadcast newsletter channel JIDs (@newsletter), and customer JIDs (@s.whatsapp.net) remain globally unique and immutable across sessions.
rationale: Multi-tenant routing maps physical WhatsApp JIDs directly to shop tenant slugs in the database.
machine_specification: tenant_resolver.mjs maintains in-memory Map<JID, tenantSlug> cache. command_handler.mjs verifies sender JID against authorized management group before executing administrative commands (!stock, !price, !product).
business_requirement: NFR-4 [Security & Multi-Tenancy Isolation]: Zero cross-tenant data leakage.
falsification_scenario: Group JID changes due to group recreation, or WhatsApp alters JID suffixes in a protocol upgrade.
mitigation_strategy: !shop bind <slug> [floor|management|channel] CLI command allows instantaneous rebinding of new JIDs without code modifications.

title: Residential Zero-Port-Forwarding Inbound Inaccessibility
statement: The local home server runs behind Carrier-Grade NAT (CGNAT) where traditional router port forwarding (ports 80/443) is strictly blocked by the ISP.
rationale: Residential ISPs in Kenya do not assign static public IPv4 addresses to standard home packages.
machine_specification: Zero-trust outbound tunnels via cloudflared and Tailscale WireGuard mesh (100.73.175.118). Webhooks from external services enter via Cloudflare Tunnel edge terminating at localhost:5174.
business_requirement: NFR-5 [Perimeter Security]: Zero open WAN ports on residential router, impervious to public IP port scanning.
falsification_scenario: Tunnel daemon crashes or Tailscale service drops authentication.
mitigation_strategy: watch_pavilion_and_migrate.ps1 and systemd auto-restart daemons monitor connection health every 10 seconds and re-establish tunnels autonomously.
